sentences.text: Today we are going to a beautiful island city called Ambon.
Ambon is part of Indonesia, a country made of thousands of islands.
It is a city of music, beaches, and warm people.
Let's explore Ambon together.
Part two.
Where is Ambon?
Ambon is in the Maluku Islands in the eastern part of Indonesia.
It is surrounded by the blue waters of the Banda Sea.
The city is small but very lively.
Ambon has both mountains and beaches.
You can see the ocean from many places in the city.
Part three.
The nature of Ambon.
Ambon is full of green hills, palm trees, and tropical flowers.
The weather is warm and humid all year.
It rains a lot, which keeps everything fresh and green.
You can find waterfalls, coral reefs, and beautiful sunsets.
Nature is part of everyday life here.
Part four.
The city of Ambon.
Ambon City is small but full of color.
There are markets, shops, and small restaurants.
People ride motorbikes and the streets are full of music and laughter.
In the morning, you can see fishermen selling fresh fish by the sea.
In the evening, families walk together near the harbor.
Part five.
The people in music.
The people of Ambon are famous for their love of music.
Almost everyone can sing or play an instrument.
You can hear guitars, drums, and sweet voices in every corner.
Children learn songs from their parents and sing at school.
Music brings people together.
It's part of their happiness.
Part six.
Food in Ambon.
Ambon's food is very tasty.
People love fish, rice, and spices.
A popular dish is ikan bakar, which means grilled fish.
They also eat papaya, a special dish made from sago, a local plant.
It's sticky and eaten with fish soup.
Locals love it.
Coconut and chili are used in many dishes.
Food in Ambon is full of flavor and color.
Part seven.
The people in life.
People in Ambon are very friendly.
They smile a lot and love to talk to visitors.
Family is very important here.
People live close to their parents and grandparents.
Many work as teachers, farmers, fishermen, or shop owners.
Life is simple but happy.
Part eight.
The sea and the islands.
The sea is a big part of life in Ambon.
People travel between islands by boat.
Children swim and play in the water every day.
You can go snorkeling or diving and see colorful fish and coral.
The sea around Ambon is clear like glass.
You can see everything.
Part nine.
History and culture.
Ambon has a long history.
Many years ago, it was part of the spice islands where people traded nutmeg, cloves, and cinnamon.
Today, you can still smell these spices in the air.
Ambon has both churches and mosques, and people of different religions live peacefully together.
Part 10.
Weather and seasons.
Ambon is warm all year.
There are two main seasons, the rainy season and the dry season.
When it rains, it rains a lot.
But after the rain, the air smells fresh and clean.
The best time to visit is between June and September, when the weather is sunny and perfect for the beach.
Part 11.
Why people visit Ambon?
Travelers come to Ambon to enjoy nature, music, and kindness.
It is not crowded like big cities.
You can relax, swim, or join locals in a music festival.
Ambon also has beautiful islands nearby, like Saram and Saperuwa.
Great for short boat trips.
Part 12.
Why Ambon is special?
Ambon is not a famous city, but it is full of heart.
It has beautiful nature, friendly people, and a deep love for music.
